subject.title: fix(msteams): bound Graph collection JSON response to prevent unbounded read

question: Should this PR's 256 KiB fail-closed limit for MS Teams Graph message and hostedContents JSON reads be accepted once the accidental stack dump is removed?
rationale: The cap is a security/availability hardening improvement, but it intentionally changes how unusually large successful Graph attachment metadata responses behave on an existing shipped path.

options.title: Accept the cap after cleanup
options.body: Remove `bash.exe.stackdump` and land the bounded-reader hardening with the documented oversized-response behavior.

options.title: Revise cap behavior first
options.body: Ask for a larger/shared provider JSON cap or different overflow handling before merge if 256 KiB is too tight for real tenants.

options.title: Pause for a broader policy
options.body: Hold this PR with the sibling MS Teams bounded-read PRs if maintainers want one consistent cap policy across all Teams Graph/Bot Framework JSON reads.

recommendation.title: Accept the cap after cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove `bash.exe.stackdump` and land the bounded-reader hardening with the documented oversized-response behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current MS Teams Graph attachment implementation and are the clearest available owner for accepting the compatibility/availability tradeoff.
